translation:
S-Suzumiya, I heard something funny from
Kyon…
Umm… Well it's… It's about Nagato.

It seems Nagato is somewhat interested in
the computer society activities.
I-I think it's true! Kyon said so after all.
Then it's just something Kyon made up.

There's no way Yuki could be interested in the
activities of those slovenly weirdos.

What a pain—I'll have to give Kyon a stern
lecture later.

Getting even Mikuru caught up in his
delinquency…

Absolutely. He spread a rumor that could've
spiraled our brigade's unity into chaos.

He definitely needs to be taught a lesson.
Let's hurry and find him.
N-no… It's not like that… Uwaaaa…
